name: Pragma BioSynth Pharmaceutical Researcher Full Rig
description: Crisp white long-line lab coat with an integrated climate layer and sealed wrist cuffs over charcoal slim-fit trousers, both bearing a Pragma BioSynth embossed security strip at the collar. A slim wraparound safety visor with UV-filter coating sits over a close-fit white cap that covers BCI port access. Thin-film chemically resistant gloves in translucent pale blue seal over the cuff and allow full dexterity for pipette work. White closed-toe composite shoes with slip-resistant soles complete the look, and a hip-mounted compact satchel holds compound logs, a portable spectrometer, and sealed sample vials.
functionality: Integrated climate layer maintains stable body temperature in cold research environments; thin-film gloves resist broad-spectrum chemical exposure while preserving pipette-level dexterity.
what_it_says: This person is building the next compound that will either save ten thousand lives or be sold exclusively to the top two tiers — and they already know which is more likely.
story_hooks: The portable spectrometer in the satchel has an off-book analysis mode that cross-references street drug compounds — someone has been running Shelf samples through a Pragma machine.
The compound log contains a formula with no trial number and no patient cohort — just the notation 'self-administered, day 14.'
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: Clinical and authoritative — a sharp silhouette that reads as both functional and hierarchical. The extended white coat drapes past the hips, creating an elongated vertical line. The crisp geometry is broken only by the wraparound visor's subtle curve and the satchel's organic bulge at the hip. Projects Tier 1-2 corpo prestige within a controlled, sterile aesthetic.
physical_description.fit: Tailored precision with compression elements. The coat is slim through the torso with subtle articulated panels at the shoulders and elbows for mobility. Charcoal trousers are slim-fit with a slight taper, allowing full range of motion without excess fabric. The close-fit cap and visor create a snug, secure feeling around the head.
physical_description.primary_material: Treated biosynth-cotton blend for the coat (stain and fluid resistant), performance charcoal twill for trousers, translucent thermoplastic elastomer for gloves, polycarbonate composite for shoes and visor lens.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and clinical — the coat has a subtle sheen from its chemical-resistant treatment. Gloves carry a slight tackiness for grip. Visor lens is optically clear with an almost invisible UV-reactive coating. Shoes have a textured, non-slip sole pattern visible from below.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pristine white (coat, cap, shoes) with charcoal gray trousers. Translucent pale blue gloves add a medical coolness. The embossed security strip at collar reads as subtle dark gray. Visor lens is clear with barely perceptible amber tint.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap buttons down the coat front (silent, secure, durable). Friction-fit wrist seals on the coat cuffs. Elastic pull-on cap. Wraparound visor sits snug via contoured fit. Gloves slip over sealed cuffs with a sealed overlap. Shoes have friction-lock laces (never come undone).
distinctive_features: Embossed Pragma BioSynth security strip at collar — doubles as wear verification and access credential
Integrated climate regulation layer in coat lining (subtle quilting visible at seams)
Sealed wrist cuffs designed to overlap with glove cuffs — prevents contamination ingress
UV-filter wraparound visor with blue-light reduction coating
Close-fit white cap with internal BCI port access channel (fabric slightly raised at crown)
Hip-mounted compact satchel with reinforced sample vial pockets and spectrometer holster
Composite shoes with conductive grounding strip along sole edge (visible as thin silver line)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury corpo. The precision tailoring, integrated tech, and Pragma BioSynth branding signal access to high-end pharma facilities and research infrastructure. This is not off-the-rack; it's personalized labwear.
physical_description.cultural_context: Pharmaceutical researcher, biotech sector. Wearing this rig announces expertise, corporate affiliation, and authorized lab access. It carries the weight of institutional trust and regulatory compliance. The wearer is credentialed, vetted, and operating within corporate hierarchies.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. The coat maintains crisp edges and bright white despite frequent washing (treated fibers resist yellowing). Gloves show minor stress creases at knuckles from pipette work. Shoes have a barely-scuffed composite toe. The rig is replaced or professionally restored when damage occurs — this is not a secondhand garment.
